title: Derivation of packet filter for UL direction from DL user data packet

entities.name: Packet Filter Derivation Procedure
entities.description: Procedure for deriving an uplink packet filter from a downlink user data packet based on PDU session type and packet protocol characteristics.

entities.name: Uplink Packet Filter
entities.description: Packet filter components derived from downlink user data packet for uplink traffic filtering.

entities.name: IPv4 Packet Condition
entities.description: Condition where received DL user data packet is IPv4 packet in IPv4 or IPv4v6 PDU session.

entities.name: IPv6 Packet Condition
entities.description: Condition where received DL user data packet is IPv6 packet in IPv6 or IPv4v6 PDU session.

entities.name: Ethernet Packet Condition
entities.description: Condition where received DL user data packet belongs to Ethernet PDU session type.

entities.name: IPv4 Remote Address Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to source address field of received DL user data packet.

entities.name: IPv4 Local Address Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to destination address field of received DL user data packet.

entities.name: Protocol Identifier Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to protocol field (IPv4) or last next header field (IPv6) of received DL user data packet.

entities.name: Local Port Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to destination port field of received DL user data packet for TCP/UDP protocols.

entities.name: Remote Port Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to source port field of received DL user data packet for TCP/UDP protocols.

entities.name: Security Parameter Index Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to SPI of uplink IPSec SA corresponding to downlink IPSec SA for ESP protocol.

entities.name: Destination MAC Address Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to source MAC address of received DL user data packet for Ethernet PDU sessions.

entities.name: Source MAC Address Component
entities.description: Packet filter component set to destination MAC address of received DL user data packet for Ethernet PDU sessions.

relations.description: Packet filter derivation procedure creates the uplink packet filter.
IPv4 packet condition triggers the packet filter derivation procedure.
IPv6 packet condition triggers the packet filter derivation procedure.
Ethernet packet condition triggers the packet filter derivation procedure.
Uplink packet filter contains IPv4 remote address component.
Uplink packet filter contains IPv4 local address component.
Uplink packet filter contains protocol identifier component.
Uplink packet filter contains local port component for TCP/UDP protocols.
Uplink packet filter contains remote port component for TCP/UDP protocols.
Uplink packet filter contains security parameter index component for ESP protocol.
Uplink packet filter contains destination MAC address component for Ethernet PDU sessions.
Uplink packet filter contains source MAC address component for Ethernet PDU sessions.
